description: Build a cold-start handoff brief for the next agent from caller-supplied commits, open pull requests, and TODO items. Returns the brief as markdown and the counts behind it. Pure rendering over supplied facts: nothing is fetched, executed, or inferred.

commits.description: Recent commits, rendered in input order

context.description: Free-text current-state note, included verbatim when supplied (optional)

open_prs.description: Open pull requests, rendered in input order

blocked.description: Whether the pull request is blocked

source.description: Where the TODO lives, e.g. a file path (optional)

name: build_handoff_brief
